en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural village scene with two women in traditional dress and a dog in the foreground. In the background are simple houses and visible stone structures described as Roman ruins. There is a green Greek postage stamp in the upper right corner and a circular postmark. Printed captions in French and English identify the place as a Macedonian village called Turkovitci on the Salonica–Verria road.
